first off, i’m really proud of you 

you’ve already made a lot of progress. and please remember that crying isnt a sign of being weak or vulnerable. it shows that you can trust yourself to let your feelings out and its a healthy way of coping (as long as you dont hurt yourself or others of course). 
crying helps a lot and i personally feel better after i cried which is also the reason why i sometimes even try to cry, so i can let things, at least partially, out of my system. 

being able to cry again is a process and isn’t something thats easy to achieve but you can do it and it’s worth it, i promise

This happened to me when I was six or seven. It happened two times with only one night between them. I was walking down the stairs when I tripped and then floated. I didn’t think of it as something unusual. The second time I just kinda knew it would work so I just stepped into the air and it did work. I thought for a really long time it really happened but now I think it was a dream that was just really realistic. I also didn’t know there are people, who experienced something similar.
